author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಳಸಿ ಎಸೆವರು ನಿನ್ನ ತಮಗಿಷ್ಟಬಂದಂತೆ
ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಅರಿತು ಎಡವದಿರು
ಅಳುತಕೂಡುವ ಬದಲು ಅರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಿಸಿಮುಟ್ಟೆ
ಗಳಿಸುವೆಯೊ ಗೌರವವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They will use you and throw you away as they please;
understand this before you are lost, and don’t stumble;
instead of sitting and weeping, let your enemies feel the heat,
and you will earn respect, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Some people use others and discard them. See it early, don’t fall for it, and instead of self-pity, stand up to what harms you. Respect follows.
